interpretation: Development configuration comparison; no global optimality, SOTA or CPU/GPU speed ranking.

selection_rule.selection_scope: Development settings selection; no held-out certification
selection_rule.eligibility: Complete strict conversion/score and all original screens pass
selection_rule.table_groups: Separate common base grid from grid variation; identify the exact configuration of every shown row
selection_rule.representatives: Show base and minimum sea-level error per model on unchanged grid; thermal additionally show minimum temperature RMS per model. Each row retains all metrics and its setting.
selection_rule.cost: Report initialization, integration and total worker/driver elapsed separately, plus ZhenMode explicit compilation within initialization. No CPU/GPU method speed ranking.
selection_rule.negative_controls: 154 bounded tests include independent exact wave and physically valid reversed velocity detected by scoring; clock, schema, physics, threshold and option corruptions rejected.
selection_rule.regression: Base native arrays compared against prior records, with source/metadata differences retained.
selection_rule.failures: Native execution/screen/conversion failures counted distinctly. Stop for root-cause diagnosis on unexpected control or conversion failure; do not drop failed rows.
